if: taxes, duties, cesses, fees or charges are levied under any law in force other than the CGST Act, the SGST Act, the UTGST Act and the GST (Compensation to States) Act
they are charged SEPARATELY by the supplier
then: they are INCLUDED in the value of supply
note: The four GST Acts are carved out; everything else charged separately goes into the base. So GST is not charged on GST, but it IS charged on other statutory levies appearing as separate lines on the invoice.

evidence.quote: The value of supply shall include
